text:
Phonely | San Francisco, CA | Full Time | Onsite (5 days/week) | Senior Full Stack Engineer

https://phonely.ai

Phonely builds AI voice agents that automate phone calls for businesses. We’re a YC S24 company that raised our Series A in January and are looking for a senior full stack engineer to help build the future of voice AI.

Our stack includes TypeScript, Next.js, Vercel, Python, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, AWS, Redis, and modern AI models.

We’re looking for engineers who enjoy owning features end-to-end, shipping quickly, and solving hard product and infrastructure problems in a small, high-performing team.

Experience with AI, voice, or distributed systems is a plus, but not required.

Reach out with your CV to recruiting@phonely.ai with “HN Hiring” as the subject.
